name: Qingyuan IBoss Smart Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Qingyuan (Guangdong) supplier selling iBOSS PLA+, Silk/dual-colour silk, rainbow/macaron PLA and PETG (1.75 mm, +/-0.02 mm claimed) via Amazon, Newegg and Best Buy Canada. Presents on Made-in-China as a manufacturer/trading company; no OEM relationship identified.

product_lines.name: Rainbow / Macaron PLA
product_lines.notes: Rainbow mapped to gradient; macaron (pastel) colours are plain PLA chemistry.

additional_notes: Website endpoint is a Made-in-China supplier page only (audited supplier report); another page names 'IBoss Technology'. Self-reported claims of patents and a Xi'an Jiaotong University tech-transfer partnership are unverified. Because the listing is 'manufacturer/trading company', in-house extrusion is neither confirmed nor ruled out, so no relationship is encoded. Budget tier unverified. The Amazon brand '3DTOOLS' (Bambu-style product naming) is sold by '3DTOOLS Official Store', Business Name 'HK IBOSSEN TECHNOLOGY CO., LIMITED' (Flat 917A, New Mandarin Plaza, Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong; read 2026-11-06). The IBOSSEN name resembles iBOSS, but no link to Qingyuan IBoss is established; recorded here as a lead only.

provenance.conflicts: Single B2B-platform source; manufacturer vs trading-company status unresolved.
